brand_identity.tagline: The Command Center for Modern MSPs
design_principles: Density with Clarity: High information density without clutter.
Speed is a Feature: Instant interactions, no laggy animations.
Context is King: Slide-overs and modals over page navigations.
Visual Hierarchy: Color indicates status (Red=Critical, Green=Healthy, Blue=Action).

headings.usage: Page titles, widget headers, modal titles. Tracking-tight.

mono.usage: IP addresses, Ticket IDs, Serial Numbers, Logs, Code snippets.

primary.name: Electric Blue
primary.usage: Primary actions, active states, focus rings.

layout.structure: Sidebar Navigation (Left, Fixed) + Main Content Area (Right, Scrollable).

buttons.shape: rounded-md font-medium text-sm h-9 px-4 py-2

tables.header: h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0

badges.style: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

inputs.style: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

login.layout: Split screen. Left: 60% Image with dark overlay + Testimonial/Quote. Right: 40% Login Form.

tickets.layout: Full-width Table with Filters Sidebar (or Top Bar).

motion.micro_interactions: Active states on buttons, row highlights on tables.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-gray-500 is legible on dark backgrounds. Use text-gray-400 if needed.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Sidebar' component that is collapsible.
Use 'Manrope' font for all headings and 'JetBrains Mono' for IDs/IPs.
Ensure the 'Login' page uses the provided background image with a dark overlay.
For the 'Dashboard', create a responsive grid layout.
Mock data should be realistic IT data (e.g., 'Server-01', 'Error 500', 'Patch Missing').
Use the provided avatar URLs for user profiles in the UI.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not introduce new random colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
